_readme: Template for the FR-56 Amharic blind test. Copy to samples/private/amharic-eval/cases.json (git-ignored) and write 25 cases: 10 amharic, 10 mixed, 5 rewrite, spread over telegram, x and linkedin. topic = the check-in, written the way you would really write it. For a rewrite, topic holds the facts and draft holds the English draft to write again in Amharic.
